name: Easy Redirect — Advanced Redirection, 404 Manager and Domain Name Redirection
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Easy Redirect is the most flexible tool to redirect url to another url wordpress users trust for SEO protection and site migrations. It is a professional-grade redirection and 404-management suite designed for agencies, developers, and SEO experts.

Upgrade to Pro: Unlock All Premium Features & Priority Support

🌐 Domain-Wide Redirection & Migration (Premium Only)

This module handles the “Big Picture” of your site’s URL structure, replacing dozens of manual .htaccess edits.
* Total Domain Migration: Move from old-site.com to new-site.com instantly. Our engine maps every old URL to the new domain while preserving the exact path.
* Master Enable/Disable Switch: Easily pause or activate your site-wide migration without losing your settings.
* Canonical URL Force: Ensure consistency by forcing HTTPS, and choosing between WWW or Non-WWW to prevent duplicate content issues.
* Whitelist Admins Bypass: Allow logged-in administrators to access the current site normally while everyone else is redirected.
* Learn more about Pro Migrations

🔥 Advanced 404 Analytics (Premium Only)

Identify your most critical site errors before they hurt your rankings.
* Top Hit Hotspots: View a dedicated list of your most frequent 404 URLs with aggregated hit counts.
* Impact Diagnostic: Instantly see which broken links are causing the most friction for your visitors.
* One-Click Resolution: Use the “Fix Now” shortcut to instantly create a redirect for your top 404 hotspots.

🔄 Advanced Redirection Manager

A comprehensive manager for individual link logic and complex matching patterns.
* Precision Status Codes: Support for 301, 302, 307, 410, and 451.
* Regex & Wildcard Support: Redirect thousands of URLs with a single rule (e.g., /blog/(.*) -> /new-blog/$1).
* Internal Notes: Perfect for agencies to track why a redirect was created.

🚨 Smart 404 Logger & Auto-Fix

Don’t just watch links break—fix them accurately to preserve your SEO juice.
* Real-Time Monitoring: Logs the URL, IP, and Referrer of every 404 error.
* Fuzzy-Match Intelligence: If a page is missing, our engine suggests the closest possible post or page to fix it with one click.
* Bot Filtering: Automatically filters out malicious crawlers to keep your logs clean and actionable.

🌍 Geolocation-Based Targeting (Premium Only)

Personalize your site routing based on where your visitors live.
* Country Redirection: Send French visitors to /fr/ and Japanese visitors to /jp/ automatically using high-speed IP detection.
* Localized Campaigns: Perfect for geo-restricted content or country-specific promotions.
* Available in Easy Redirect Pro

🔐 Role-Based & Bypass (Whitelist) Logic (Premium Only)

  • Exclusion Whitelist: Specify that roles like Administrator should bypass redirects. Test your site without being redirected away by your own rules!
  • Membership Routing: Send “Subscribers” to a premium area and “Customers” to their dashboard immediately upon login.

🔎 Redirect Chain & Loop Auditor (Premium Only)

  • Loop Detection: Instantly find rules that point to each other (A→B→A) to prevent browser errors.
  • Chain Optimization: Identify and flatten redirect chains (A→B→C) to speed up your site and maximize SEO “link juice.”

⏰ Scheduling & Expiry Actions (Premium Only)

  • Start & End Dates: Set redirects to go live and expire automatically for seasonal marketing.
  • Expiry Actions: Choose to Auto-Delete, Disable, or divert to a Fallback URL once a rule ends.

🧪 Redirect Tester (Simulator) Tool

  • Safe Simulation: Enter a URL in the dashboard to see exactly which rule would fire, where it will go, and if conditions are met—without ever leaving your admin area.

📱 Device & Event Intelligence (Premium Only)

  • Mobile Routing: Send mobile visitors to an app store or a mobile-optimized landing page.
  • Event Hooks: Trigger redirects on User Login, Logout, or Registration.

📦 Bulk Data & Migration Tools

  • CSV Import/Export: Manage thousands of redirects in Excel and import them in seconds.
  • Competitor Importer: Effortlessly move data from Redirection, RankMath, or Yoast SEO.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the easy-redirect-advanced-redirection folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the dashboard via the ‘Easy Redirect’ menu.
sections.faq:
How do I redirect url to another url wordpress?

With Easy Redirect, it’s effortless. Just go to our Redirect Manager, enter your source and target paths, and click Save. Our smart engine handles the rest, ensuring a 100% SEO-safe transition.

Is it faster than .htaccess?

Yes. We use optimized custom SQL tables, which is significantly faster and safer than parsing the WordPress Options API or risk breaking your server’s .htaccess file.

Can I import from the “Redirection” plugin?

Yes. We include a one-click migration tool for all major competitors.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Added Dedicated 404 Analytics View (Pro).
  • Added “Most Hit 404 URLs” tracking and aggregation.
  • Added Master Enable/Disable switch for Global Domain Migrations.
  • Added “Whitelist Admins” bypass for Domain Migrations.
  • Implemented Skeleton Loading architecture for smoother dashboard transitions.
  • Fixed several AJAX persistence issues with Domain-Wide settings.
  • Improved UI contrast for toggle switches and navigation items.

1.1.0

  • Major UI/UX rebuild (SPA Dashboard).
  • Added Domain-Wide Redirection module.
  • Added Geo-Targeting, Device, and Event-based logic.
  • Added Internal Chain & Loop Auditor.
  • Added Expiry Actions and Fallback URL support.
  • Improved 404 monitor with Bot Detection.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release.
